note: Suvo supplied two fictionalized HDFC body shapes on 2026-10-11 and confirmed on 2026-10-15 that both came from the HDFCBK-S sender family. VM-, AD- and JM- labels were reported; exact prefix/body pairings were not asserted. The shared credit-reference text had its last four digits masked by the user, so this fixture uses a wholly fictional 12-digit value. All amounts, dates, account/card digits, VPAs, references and contact numbers shown here are fictional. The card and credit body shapes are observed; all date variants and other boundary cases are synthetic constructions, not additional bank samples or a universal-coverage corpus.
